ci.rationale: Builds container images and deploys services to Kubernetes/Docker Compose following the Tiltfile, modifying infrastructure in expected and bounded ways.

doctor.rationale: Prints diagnostic information about the Tilt environment without modifying any state.

down.rationale: Deletes Kubernetes resources and optionally namespaces/volumes, which is irreversible and has broad blast radius.

dump.rationale: Exports internal Tilt state and diagnostic information to stdout without modifying anything.

get.rationale: Queries and displays Tilt resources without modifying them.

logs.rationale: Retrieves and optionally streams logs from a running Tilt instance without modifying state.

status.rationale: Not a valid tilt command; attempting to run it produces an error and has no effect.

up.rationale: Starts Tilt and runs services defined in the Tiltfile, modifying infrastructure through container builds and resource application.
